text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O has been struggling
somewhat
in training lately, so we
decide to pay a visit to
the local shrine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan? What a coincidence. Are you
here to
pray?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I decided to stop by during my
walk. I'm
taking a moment to admire the
guardian
lion-dogs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Their stature conveys a reliable strength,
yet the
form they take reminds me of the
sweet therapy
dog I met as a child.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Therapy dogs? You mean the ones that
keep
people company when they're
sick?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. When I was too ill to even leave
my house, we would have a dog come
visit and play
with me every once in a
while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thinking about that dear pup
makes me
want to see it again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Interesting...
But it's definitely true that being
with a doggy can help cheer you
up when you're
feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, why don't we go to a dog cafe
now? We
can play with all kinds of
doggies while enjoying
tea there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, such a wonderful place
exists? I'd love
to go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're okay with that, right, Trainer?
Great! Then
let me just pray real quick,
and we'll be off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
May I continue to enjoy running! And
may good
things happen to everyone
around me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm back! Let me just make sure the cafe
is open
right now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, good! It's open and... Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! They're holding a special
event right
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, you can paint on the
doggies' paw
pads and make art with
their prints!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My, that sounds like a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it?! I can't even imagine how
cute it's
going to be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I guess my prayers were answered.

Something good happened right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This turn of events puts Sakura Chiyono
O in a great mood, and all that positive
energy helps her
bounce back in
training, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What?! They're temporarily closed! I'm
sorry... It
looks like we're not going to a
dog cafe today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see... Well, we can go another time...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I suppose... but I was so ready to cuddle
doggies
with all my might...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now what am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, our shrine visit doesn't do
much to
help Sakura Chiyono O's
mood...
